info.name: Docker Store API (v1)
info.description:
E-commerce modular monolith: users + orders.

How to run:
1. Start the project: docker compose up --build -d
   (after pulling a change to db/init.sql, reset the database first: docker compose down -v)
2. If you changed PORT, ADMIN_EMAIL or ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env, update the collection variables host, adminEmail, adminPassword.
3. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner). Every request has tests.

Folder 3 is the access-control proof: another customer's order, actions outside your role,
missing and forged tokens are all rejected.

The collection registers two fresh customers on every run, so it can be run again without a reset.
